entries.story_action: Immediate aftermath from Scene 01. Claire remains at the window with phone lowered slightly; disbelief has become alert fear.
entries.visual_media: New Scene 02 hero preserving H06 continuity: same Claire, wardrobe, apartment, window orientation and pre-dawn weather.
entries.animation_behavior: Near-locked camera; coherent storm system continues through exterior rain, moving cloud mass, glass reflection, wet response and practical-light interaction. No new system behavior yet.

entries.story_action: An ordinary apartment device changes state without Claire touching it.
entries.visual_media: Hero coverage of established room with router/status display or ordinary screen in believable position.
entries.animation_behavior: Device light changes locally first; room remains physically still; source-local cyan spill only. Storm remains exterior/window coupled.

entries.story_action: Claire notices the unexplained state change and turns her attention toward it.
entries.visual_media: Profile/detail hero consistent with Scene 01 Claire and chained from an approved Scene 02 start frame.
entries.animation_behavior: Use bounded temporal continuation for a real attention shift: eyes/head/upper-body move naturally while face identity, hands, phone, wardrobe and apartment geometry remain locked. No invented props or camera move.

entries.story_action: Multiple ordinary indicators/screens begin changing in synchronized sequence.
entries.visual_media: Room-wide hero with separate civilian systems visible; no holograms or speculative floating UI.
entries.animation_behavior: Independent device sources change in a controlled sequence; local light responses only; no global pulse. Storm/window behavior remains coherent and subordinate.

entries.story_action: Claire looks through the established window orientation as nearby Paris buildings change in coordinated bands.
entries.visual_media: Exterior-facing hero from the same apartment/window geography.
entries.animation_behavior: Practical multiplane depth; selected building lights/screens change together; coherent storm adds depth-layered rain, moving clouds, wet-surface response and wind-readable direction. Rain remains exterior.

entries.story_action: The city-scale pattern becomes unmistakable: systems remain powered but change state in organized waves.
entries.visual_media: Wide Paris hero with deep foreground/midground/background separation.
entries.animation_behavior: Readable layer differential plus controlled bands of infrastructure state change; coherent storm operates as one force system across clouds, rain, haze, wet response and distant lightning. Avoid random blackout/cyberpunk spectacle.

entries.story_action: Claire returns to the phone as Daniel explains that the systems are not failing; they are transferring authority.
entries.visual_media: Claire/phone hero continuing established profile language and chained from approved Scene 02 continuity media.
entries.animation_behavior: Bounded temporal continuation may provide natural breathing, listening, mouth/eye response and small phone-hand adjustment. Score ducks; storm and device behavior continue behind her without geometry drift.

continuation_contract.allowed_action: subtle listening/speaking reaction while holding phone

entries.story_action: A brief breath of near-silence while Claire processes the statement and looks back toward the city.
entries.visual_media: Tight Claire/window composition chained from S2-07 terminal continuity state.
entries.animation_behavior: Very small real temporal turn/reorientation is allowed; otherwise keep near stillness. Minimal glass/rain motion; no camera shake; permit 0.5-1.5s editorial score attenuation.

continuation_contract.allowed_action: small processing beat and glance toward city

entries.story_action: Proof: an ordinary public/civil screen or coordinated government channel displays a prepared transition status that could only have existed beforehand.
entries.visual_media: Grounded diegetic proof hero, visible from apartment or ordinary screen; no exposition card replacing the scene.
entries.animation_behavior: Source-local display change, restrained room response, controlled city synchronization; score returns with weight. Typography/UI remains physically contained to the diegetic screen.

entries.story_action: Claire acts for the first time: she moves away from the window to gather essentials and follow Daniel's instruction, leaving the controlled transition visible behind her.
entries.visual_media: Action hero preserving apartment geography and Scene 01 wardrobe until a motivated change occurs; start from approved continuity frame and chain accepted terminal frame into Scene 03.
entries.animation_behavior: True temporal motion required. Claire turns and crosses a bounded portion of the established room, interacts with one pre-approved existing object or gathers essentials, while the exterior storm/city coordination continues coherently behind her. Camera remains locked or performs only a predeclared restrained move.

continuation_contract.audio_policy: generated ambience/SFX may be retained only after mix/QC; dialogue remains locked to caption timing
continuation_contract.allowed_action: turn from window, move through established room, gather one pre-approved existing essential
